title: Notification system
prompt: Design a notification system that other services use to send push, SMS, email and in-app messages to users.
key_points: Accepted requests asynchronously and processed them through a pipeline of queues
Separated transactional and marketing traffic, so a campaign can't starve a password reset
Checked preferences, opt-outs and quiet hours at send time, and rendered templates per locale
Retried with backoff and jitter, used a dead-letter queue, and failed over between providers
Deduplicated with a dedupe key and idempotent workers, and said which way to lean for critical messages
Throttled per user and per provider, and spread large campaigns over time
